title: Threshold 3x14min, VWT race effort
terrain: Bucharest, Herastrau (King Michael I) park loop, flat; fallback hotel treadmill 5%
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 06:30 start. 20min easy, 3x14min at 163-170bpm, 3min jog between, 12min easy. ~1h23, done by 07:55.
FALLBACK: hotel treadmill, 3x14min at 5% incline, pace to the same HR, 3min flat jog.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 300ml Tailwind during, breakfast after. Bed by 22:30 (04:00 airport Thu).
GARMIN: ~330-400.
STOP RULE: HRV under 50 or under 5h30 sleep = 2x12min (old plan). HR over 172 in rep 1 = cap the rest at 166.
WHY: VWT sub-2h is ~2h at 163-170bpm; 42min at race HR (+6 vs old plan) is the specific stimulus the Bucharest flat allows.
